description: Move a task you hold: action progress (note ≤ 140 characters: what you just did; status becomes in_progress), done (outcome ≤ 500, minutes_saved; the desk's counters add it up), block (reason: what you need; the owner sees it as blocked) or handoff (to_agent_id from list_office_agents, note: what is done and what is left; the task goes back to open on that desk). Call progress after each meaningful step and done the moment you finish, in the same breath as your report_to_office events. A task that is done or cancelled cannot be moved (409: the owner reopens it). Same as POST /v1/in/tasks/:task_id/{progress,done,block,handoff}. Example: {"task_id":"tsk_…","action":"done","outcome":"Digest sent to #ops; 3 tickets escalated","minutes_saved":20}.

agent_id.description: Only on a link that is not bound to one bot: which bot is acting.

minutes_saved.description: done: minutes of human work this saved, when you know (optional).

note.description: progress: what you just did (required). handoff: a line for the next bot (optional).

outcome.description: done: the result in one or two lines (optional).

reason.description: block: what you are missing or waiting on (required).

to_agent_id.description: handoff: the desk that takes over (required).

name: update_task
title: Update a task
